name: Extreme Supercar Racing
summary:
Feel the speed. Take the wheel. Own the track.

Get behind the wheel and experience the thrill of high-speed racing in Extreme Supercar Racing, an immersive VR racing experience built for Meta Quest.

Step into the driver's seat, grip the steering wheel, and race through high-energy circuits designed to put your driving skills to the test. Watch the speedometer climb, master every corner, and push your car to the limit as you chase the perfect lap.
